capabilities: insert a frontmatter template on new empty Markdown notes
auto-update the updated date on save
run a read-only metadata health check and write a report note
configure field vocabularies and a custom template
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. If not listed in the community plugin directory, it can be installed manually or via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically populate frontmatter on new notes or check that metadata fields follow a consistent convention across a vault.

relations.evidence: Works with Obsidian Properties, Dataview, Bases, and standard YAML frontmatter.
Works with Obsidian Properties, Dataview, Bases, and standard YAML frontmatter.

summary: Frontmatter tool that auto-inserts a stable YAML frontmatter template on new notes, updates the updated date on save, and audits metadata conventions.
